manual_reasoning_checks: Read every complete prompt, solution and rubric. Exact statements and conditions determine all answers without a missing policy election, undisclosed balance or unprovided tax rule.

Hazel opening and closing statements both balance at 169. The temporary debit allowance requires expense 7. With net receivables, adding that expense again is wrong; independently journaled operating cash is 14 and closing cash is 79.

Revised machine life is based on genuinely new information and remains prospective. The stipulated impairment-reversal ceiling is 40; reversal is 5. Alternative sale is a separate branch and reconciles only the supplied carrying-history period.

Premium amortization lowers liability and requires subtraction in the note operating-cash bridge; retirement gain is not operating cash. The prepaid lease amount is in ROU but excluded from unpaid liability; its two-year cash/expense closure agrees.

Treasury shortfall uses only the supplied treasury premium before retained earnings. Full NCI begins at independently supplied 60; upstream unrealized margin affects subsidiary attribution, and closing NCI 74.4 retains its initial fair-value premium.

Taxable profit, current payable, asset DTL, warranty DTA and permanent fine have distinct roles. Deferred amounts are recognized under the supplied future-profit condition. Tax expense minus tax cash reconciles current payable plus net deferred expense.

Exhaustive feasible sets establish the indivisibility counterexample and expansion optimum. Special-order opportunity cost is the best displaced plan and is deducted once. Cash-funded debt payment leaves net debt unchanged while current and quick ratios move in opposite directions.
All return ratios use matched averages and a single common-equity class. Both invested-capital routes agree at 120; NOPAT is 32 and ROIC 4/15, distinct from levered common-owner NI.

New borrowing occurs at the start of the year, bears full-year paid interest and has no tax relief. Required draw 280/9 exceeds 30; the capped statements still balance but cash 9 fails the 10 minimum. Removing a genuinely undeclared, uncommitted distribution preserves the operating/capex inputs and repairs the model with draw 260/9.

Segment eliminations remove equal internal revenue and expense because all internal output is sold externally/consumed. Corporate costs, interest and tax reconcile to group NI 42. Symmetric normalization yields 59 rather than management 67, without changing historical cash or proving intent.

All twenty rubrics allocate exactly five explicit points; every domain has twenty. Consequential arithmetic errors receive method credit when coherent; conceptual errors are not rewarded. Equivalent correct reasoning and evidence choices are accepted.

Methods were cross-checked against the accepted chapter teaching. Five-part architecture and anchors were sent to root early, and root coordinated structural distinction from Form A. Root reports a separate full twenty-part prompt/solution and checker audit with no unresolved numerical issue.
